name_en: Kagawa nasu somen — eggplant and somen noodles simmered in dashi
summary_ja: 油で炒めたなすを油揚げや唐辛子とともにいりこ出汁で煮て、ゆでたそうめんを加える夏の家庭料理。小豆島特産のそうめんとなすを合わせやすいことから、手軽な主食として広く浸透しているという。
summary_en: Eggplant pan-fried in oil is simmered with fried tofu and chili in dried-sardine dashi, then combined with boiled somen noodles for a summer home dish. Said to have spread widely as an easy staple, pairing well the somen noodles for which Shodoshima is known with locally grown eggplant.
source_title: なすそうめん 香川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Tai somen — a whole simmered sea bream served over somen noodles
summary_ja: 塩でしめたタイを一匹丸ごと醤油と砂糖、酒で煮崩れないように煮込み、ゆでたそうめんとともに大皿に盛る婚礼料理。座卓ごと揺すりながら運ぶ讃岐伊勢音頭の演出とともに供されてきたという。
summary_en: A whole salt-cured sea bream is simmered gently in soy sauce, sugar, and sake so it holds its shape, then served on a large platter with boiled somen noodles — a wedding-feast centerpiece traditionally carried in while the table is rocked to a Sanuki Ise Ondo tune.
source_title: 鯛そうめん 香川県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
